I have $1035 and two properties. I am considering whether to trade or mortgage. Player 1 has three railroads and several other properties.

Player 1 still needs Virginia to complete the pink monopoly. Indiana is orange and Marvin Gardens is yellow, so those monopolies are also incomplete. Player 2 has one green, one brown, and one railroad. Player 4 has only one green.

I will end my turn. Trading away Vermont would destroy my only color set path, and Water Works is too weak to trade for cash. I have enough money to hold both properties without mortgaging.
